title: Pinky's Kayak Rentals
specs: Self-guided kayak tours on Armand Bayou and connecting waterways including Big Island Slough, Spring Gully, Horsepen Bayou, and Lake Mark Kramer
Must be at least 7 years old to kayak and able to paddle; must be in tandem kayak if under 14
Must be 14 to rent a single kayak
All minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian; siblings or boyfriends/girlfriends are not guardians
Everyone 13 and under must wear a PFD (life jacket)
Group rates with 20% discount for 5 or more kayaks; suitable for military groups, corporate retreats, meetups, birthdays, scouts, reunions, church groups, birding, clean up crews
includes: Kayaks, PFD (life jackets), paddle per person, seatbacks, water, instructions, safety briefing
gap: Weight limits for kayakers not stated
blurb: Guests rent single or tandem kayaks for self-guided tours launching from Bay Area Park. Rentals include paddles, life jackets, seatbacks, water, instructions, and safety briefing. Group rentals with 20% discount available for 5 or more kayaks.
extraNote: Cancellations require at least 48 hours notice for individual rentals and 7 days for group events for full refund · No refunds for cancellations less than required notice, no-shows, late arrivals, or inappropriate behavior · Bay Area Park, 7500 Bay Area Blvd, Pasadena, TX
